## Installation

Install as executable:

```shell
cargo install --locked repotasks
```

Install as library dependency in your package:

```shell
cargo add repotasks
```

## Usage

```shell
Usage: repotasks print --path <PATH>
       repotasks fnox github init-age-key [OPTIONS]

Options:
  -h, --help     Print help
  -V, --version  Print version

repotasks print:
  -p, --path <PATH>  
  -h, --help         Print help
  -V, --version      Print version

repotasks fnox:
  -h, --help     Print help
  -V, --version  Print version

repotasks fnox github:
  -h, --help     Print help
  -V, --version  Print version

repotasks fnox github init-age-key:
      --vault <VAULT>  1Password vault for the repository key [default: Repos]
  -h, --help           Print help
  -V, --version        Print version
```
